minimum_delta_recommendation: Require every old platform_question_id, platform_frame_id and rect_id to be a non-empty trimmed string; apply the same rule in snapshot and export decoders.
Forbid literal and many-to-one lookup rules for identity outputs, or retain and compare a trusted raw identity alongside any canonical identity.
Attach a trusted full raw-record digest to every projected question, frame and directory record and require it in preservation comparisons; do not rely only on selected fields.
Bind complete-export state_version and natural-export qualification state_binding to the current snapshot catalog/version instead of checking only truthiness.
Require an independently observed authoritative catalog membership/count binding before accepting an empty or reduced old-question denominator; do not hardcode historical 22/68 counts.
Keep CURRENT_SCHEMA_UNBOUND and HOLD until real responses establish the actual field paths and binding values; do not invent platform fields.
